{{Quote|Our target? Jock Tardee, the wealthy independent industrialist. The one you've failed to... entice|Leia Organa to Sarin|<ref name="Rebel Heist 2" />}}
'''Jock Tardee''' was a wealthy independent industrialist associated with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He spent [[Time/Legends|time]] in a [[Jock Tardee's palace|palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Feddasyr]] and, at one point, [[Sarin]], an undercover [[Agent/Legends|agent]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], failed to get him interested in them.<ref name="Rebel Heist 2" />
